description: This file generates precomputed elliptic curve tables for P256 in the BoringSSL cryptography library, including functions to create multiples and combinations of curve points, and writes them into C header files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that calls table writing functions for P256.

methods.name: writeP256NistzTable
methods.description: Generates a precomputed table of elliptic curve points for P256 and writes it to a header file.

methods.name: writeP256Table
methods.description: Generates a different set of precomputed tables for P256 and writes to a header file.

methods.name: makeMultiples
methods.description: Creates a table of multiples of the generator point shifted by a specified amount.

methods.name: makeComb
methods.description: Creates a table of combined points based on binary representation of scalars.

methods.name: toMontgomery
methods.description: Converts a big.Int to Montgomery form modulo the curve's prime.

methods.name: bigIntToU64s
methods.description: Converts a big.Int to a slice of uint64 words.

methods.name: bigIntToU32s
methods.description: Converts a big.Int to a slice of uint64 words representing 32-bit chunks.

methods.name: writeIndent
methods.description: Writes indentation spaces to an io.Writer.

methods.name: writeWords
methods.description: Writes a slice of words to an io.Writer with formatting.

methods.name: writeBNMont
methods.description: Writes a big.Int in Montgomery form as an array of words.

methods.name: writeU64Mont
methods.description: Writes a big.Int in Montgomery form as 64-bit words.

methods.name: writeU32Mont
methods.description: Writes a big.Int in Montgomery form as 32-bit words.

methods.name: writeTable
methods.description: Writes a table of elliptic curve points to an io.Writer.

methods.name: writeTables
methods.description: Writes multiple tables of elliptic curve points to an io.Writer.
